meta.note: Maps major Indian cities to the water board that serves them. hasTariffFile is true only where a real, schema-validated tariff JSON exists in src/data/water-tariffs/ — every other city still uses the honest self-rate-input calculator. Mirrors the discoms.json / gas-cgds.json pattern. IMPORTANT: unlike DISCOMs/CGDs, our /water/[slug] route is STATE-granularity (one page per state/UT), while water boards are CITY-granularity (a state can have multiple boards, e.g. Maharashtra has both BMC for Mumbai and PMC for Pune). Delhi and Chennai happen to work cleanly as city routes distinct from their state slugs (see src/app/water/[slug]/page.tsx, which now checks board slugs independently of state slugs). BWSSB and BMC were researched but NOT added: their published rates conflict by large margins across every secondary source we could reach, and their official portals were unreachable (cert error / non-machine-readable legacy portal) — publishing either with a confident SOURCED label would risk a wrong number. Revisit if better sources turn up. Boards below other than DJB and CMWSSB are listed for future reference only.
